accessControl.tenantScopeNote: All patterns are scoped to the authenticated user's tenantId per BR-001. Cross-tenant pattern access is blocked at the API layer.

onLoad.description: Fetch paginated list of business patterns for the tenant. Tenant scope is enforced at the API layer (BR-001). INT-002 stub returns empty list (OPEN-004).
